message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "diagnosis", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest X-ray with severe skeletal deformity to determine the primary cause of respiratory symptoms (dyspnea/cough).", "steps": ["Assess the thoracic spine and rib cage for severe curvature, rotation, and asymmetry indicative of scoliosis.", "Evaluate the lung fields for signs of acute pathology such as consolidation (pneumonia), air-fluid levels (effusion), or visceral pleural lines (pneumothorax).", "If acute pulmonary findings are absent but mechanical restriction from skeletal deformity is prominent, attribute respiratory symptoms to the structural abnormality rather than primary lung disease."]}]}
